description: NaEr(PS₃)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaS₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.16 Å. Er is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight S atoms. There are a spread of Er-S bond distances ranging from 2.76-3.14 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three S atoms. There are a spread of P-S bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.04 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three S atoms. There are a spread of P-S bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.05 Å. There are six inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Er, and one P atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Er and one P atom. In the third S site, S is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Er, and one P atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Er, and one P atom to form distorted edge-sharing SNaEr₂P tetrahedra. In the fifth S site, S is bonded in a T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Er, and one P atom. In the sixth S site, S is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Er, and one P atom.
